statement: Use the client runtime prompt, the governing documents, and the authorized images. Do not treat a batch boundary as an intellectual-item boundary by itself. When Batch Queue Prior Open Item names an existing record, preserve that record id and its already committed assets. If the next folder does not continue that record, close it and keep its kind, template, and type; do not rewrite the close as Metadata Only. Front and verso stay one item. Distinct physical copies stay distinct records. Consecutive sections of the same chapter or term report stay one report packet unless a true physical document boundary is visible. An internal section heading is not that boundary. Metadata Only is reserved for folder, enclosure, identifier, and descriptive-inventory captures. A slight archival border can pass, including when portions are somewhat above 75 pixels. 75 pixels is not a detector. Clearly excessive capture background requires Archival Border Crop. Do not crop every black border. An unbound publication page generally requires Publication Crop to the extant page edge. A bound publication keeps cord, staples, rings, sewing, and other integral binding; do not apply a page-edge crop that severs them. These are visual controls, not filename rules. This file does not contain folder answer keys.
